Which is the best open weights Text to Video model without audio? MiniMax H3 currently leads among open weights Text to Video models without audio in the Artificial Analysis Text to Video Arena with an Elo score of 1301, followed by LTX-2.5 Fast (Elo 1214) and LTX-2.5 Pro (Elo 1204). How are Text to Video models ranked on this leaderboard? Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from user votes in blind comparisons in the Artificial Analysis Video Arena. Users compare two videos generated from the same text prompt without knowing which model created each video. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often.
